python3 -I - <<'E'
import json
q=json.load(open('drafts/quizzes/0002.json'));k=json.load(open('drafts/keys/0002.json'))
q['items'][2]['stem']="Your sponsor's budget is counted in model calls, and you may assume every call costs the same. A fixed workflow handles one booking request with 2 model calls. An agent handling the same kind of request makes 6 model calls: 5 that each request a tool, and 1 that writes the final answer. Over 200 booking requests, how many more model calls does the agent use than the workflow?"
q['items'][3]['stem']="Your team wants to keep model costs low and behaviour predictable by building one part of the assistant as a fixed workflow. Which part is best suited to that?"
q['items'][3]['options'][0]['text']="Booking a slot: always check the calendar, check training, save it, then confirm"
q['items'][5]['stem']="Your booking agent is told in its prompt to check a student's machine training first, but in testing it sometimes skips the check. The check must run on every booking without exception. Which change guarantees it?"
k['items'][2]['rationale']="The agent uses 6 model calls per request against the workflow's 2, so 4 more per request; 4 x 200 = 800. An answer of 1000 uses 5 calls for the agent, forgetting the final-answer call; 400 treats the 2 workflow calls as the only difference. Agents trade cost and latency for flexibility, which matters on a small budget."
json.dump(q,open('quizzes/0002.json','w'),indent=2);json.dump(k,open('keys/0002.json','w'),indent=2)
E
